title: Evening Adhkaar
description: Evening adhkaar are supplications recited after Asr prayer until Maghrib. The Prophet (PBUH) was consistent in reciting these and encouraged his companions to protect themselves and their families through the remembrance of Allah.

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi: The Greatest Protection
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūm. Lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm.
duas.translation: Allah — there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
duas.benefit: Whoever recites this in the evening will be protected until the morning.

duas.title: Fulfil Your Obligation to Thank Allah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika faminka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, falaka l-ḥamdu wa laka sh-shukr.
duas.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have entered the evening with, is from You alone, without partner. So to You is all praise and to You is all thanks.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this in the evening has fulfilled the obligation of thanking Allah for that day.

duas.title: Protect Yourself from All Harm
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi lladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa smihi shayʾun fī l-arḍi wa lā fī s-samāʾi wa huwa s-samīʿu l-ʿalīm.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm him.

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar: The Best Way of Seeking Forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa ana ʿabduka wa ana ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika ma staṭaʿt.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your slave. I am upon Your covenant and promise as best I can.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this with conviction in the evening and dies that night will enter Paradise.
